classification.rationale: An annual supplier risk review with methodology, supplier assessments and ratings.

summarization.headline: Kestrel Foods' ten key suppliers are performing well, with mostly Low risk ratings.
key_points: Most suppliers rated Low risk; three rated Moderate.
Port congestion and grain-price volatility were the main external pressures.
summarization.title: Annual Supplier Risk Review 2025
key_findings: Prairie Mills and Northern Oils are the strongest suppliers
Coastal Sugar, Cortez Spice and Summit Egg are rated Moderate
Halvorsen Grain Cooperative delivery and financial metrics are in line with expectations
recommendations: Monitor Coastal Sugar Refiners' financial filings
Proceed with contract renewals for Low-risk suppliers
